# 1.37.0-beta.7

Seventh beta of 1.37.0: fixes and polish.

## Temporary chat

- The temporary chat switch moved to the top right corner of the window: an incognito button that is shown in an empty chat. When the chat is temporary, the button stays and its icon is crossed out; click it again to make the chat regular.
- An empty temporary chat shows a large incognito picture with a short line about what it means. A regular empty chat stays clean.

## Composer

- The estimated cost of the next answer next to the context ring is gone.
- The total cost of the chat has a new icon.
- While recording, the microphone button lights up in the accent color and shows five dots that move with your voice. The recording time is in the button's tooltip, and it opens by itself while you hold the button to talk.
- The close button of the window lights up in the accent color instead of red.

## Models

- OpenRouter models now have Nitro variants: turn on the Nitro chip in the model list to see them. Nitro sends the request to the fastest provider of the same model.
- Models that cannot turn reasoning off no longer offer the switch, and show their lowest level instead. Models that can turn it off with the "none" level, such as Claude Haiku 5.5 through OpenRouter, now really do.

## Voice input

- Recognition through OpenRouter sends the audio the way OpenRouter documents it, and the form sent to Venice follows the standard more strictly.
- A timeout or an unexpected error now says what happened instead of leaving "Recognizing" under the input field.

## Agent browser

- In the normal approval mode the agent no longer stops to ask about steps you asked for, such as opening a chat, typing a message and sending it.
- The safety check now sees the text the agent typed and the field a key press goes to, so it judges sending a message by what is actually being sent.

## Rosa

- Switching to a profile where Rosa is turned off takes him away, and switching to one where he is on brings him back.
- When you switch profiles, Rosa's memory of the profile you leave is saved with that profile's encryption setting, not the new one's.
- Rosa finishes what he is saying before the next phrase, and his reactions are no longer cut off by the assistant's answer or his own late thoughts. He says goodbye before he leaves.
- Thanks, praise or rudeness meant for the assistant no longer make Rosa happy or upset. He takes them personally only when you call him by name.
- Rosa is full for two to three hours after his treats, not until midnight.
